title: Feature request: allow automation to change ISF and IC without changing basal
symptom: User wants to change ISF and IC based on BG, but existing methods (profile percentage change, profile change) have limitations: percentage change is restricted to 70-130% and changes basal, while profile change stops autosens working.
evidence_quote: Profile percentage change - the restrictions 70% to 130% are too tight and this method changes basal too
